recipes.name: Tinga Poblana Tostada
instructions: Add all tinga poblana sauce ingredients except for the oil and bay leaf to a blender. Puree until smooth.
Over medium-high heat, add a layer of oil and the bay leaf to a pan. Let that sizzle for 20 seconds before pouring in the sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.

Toss in whatever braised/shredded meat you are using from the fridge. Mix that up until incorporated. You want the flavor to develop, so turn the heat down to a simmer and stir frequently. Reduce until thickened, about 10 more minutes.
To assemble, add a layer of your tinga meat followed by toppings of choice. Enjoy!
